help.title: 💡 How to interpret this table:
help.prob: Mathematical probability calculated by the Dixon-Coles engine based on historical xG.
help.pinnacle: The sharpest bookmaker line. Used as a safety filter (bet is only shown if recreational bookmaker odds are higher than Pinnacle's).
help.edge: Your estimated percentage edge over the bookmaker's margin.
help.stakeKelly: Recommended conservative fraction of your total bankroll (Quarter-Kelly strategy).
